Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pihu - 10 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Vinod - 45 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Anita and Vinod stand near him.]

Nikhil: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil catches the ball.]

Vinod (gently): "Anita, listen!"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Anita (happily): "And then?"

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil plays with his dog.]

Nikhil (happily): "That's great!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil waves goodbye to Mother.]

Nikhil: "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil gets frightened and steps back.]

Nikhil: "Yes, all right."

[Nikhil hurts his knee.]

Anita: "This is amazing!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Nikhil: "Really?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Nikhil: "I'm ready!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Anita: "Hmm, I see."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Nikhil: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Vinod: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Anita: "Hmm, I see."

[Pihu applies kajal to her eyes.]

Anita (happily): "Show me too!"

[Nikhil munches on an apple.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Dad, are you okay?"

[Nikhil drinks a glass of water.]

Nikhil: "Show me too!"

[Nikhil writes in his notebook.]

Vinod: "Really?"

[Nikhil talks to his father on the phone.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
